standard-dialogue.player: Nope. Just thought I'd say hi.

during-dragon-slayer-ii.player: Hello there. Have you heard of Camorra?
Well she was a great hero during the Dragonkin Conflicts. I think she travelled to Kourend before the war ended. I'm trying to find out more about her.

during-dragon-slayer-ii.npc: Well Shayzien was founded by those fleeing the Dragonkin Conflicts. And the city has never been short of heroes. There's a good chance she was from Shayzien.

during-dragon-slayer-ii.player: But you've never heard of her?

during-dragon-slayer-ii.npc: No but that's not surprising. Most of our history was lost during Xeric's reign. There is somewhere you might find answers though.
The Shayzien Crypts. They were built before the kingdom even existed. Some of the oldest Shayzien heroes are buried there.

during-dragon-slayer-ii.player: Let me guess. There's a catch isn't there?

during-dragon-slayer-ii.npc: I'm afraid so. For hundreds of years, the crypts have been overrun by the dead. We've tried clearing them out but they just come back again.

during-dragon-slayer-ii.player: Well thankfully I'm afraid of no ghost. Where do I start?

during-dragon-slayer-ii.npc: They're zombies, not ghosts. You'll find the entrance to the crypts in the Graveyard of Heroes, south of our chapel. Be careful.

during-dragon-slayer-ii-talking-to-ameli.player: Hello there. Have you heard of Camorra?

during-dragon-slayer-ii-talking-to-ameli.npc: I'm sure we've already spoken about this.

during-dragon-slayer-ii-talking-to-ameli.player: We probably have. I'm very forgetful.

during-dragon-slayer-ii-talking-to-ameli.npc: The most likely place to find answers is the Shayzien Crypts. You'll find the entrance in the Graveyard of Heroes, south of our chapel. Be careful, it's filled with zombies.
